sql-service.name: telecaps.sql.performance.min
sql-service.query: SELECT REG_TIME, STATIC_OCC, CP_OCC, SM_OCC, IDLE_OCC FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(B.REG_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN C.OID_NAME = 'StaticOcc' THEN C.VALUE END) AS STATIC_OCC, MAX(CASE WHEN C.OID_NAME = 'CallpOcc' THEN C.VALUE END) AS CP_OCC, MAX(CASE WHEN C.OID_NAME = 'SysMgmtOcc' THEN C.VALUE END) AS SM_OCC, MAX(CASE WHEN C.OID_NAME = 'IdleOcc' THEN C.VALUE END) AS IDLE_OCC FROM MS_MIB A, MS_VALUE B, MS_VALUE_MIN C WHERE A.MIB_ID = B.MIB_ID AND B.VALUE_ID = C.VALUE_ID AND A.DEVICE_ID = ?deviceId AND A.OID_TYPE = 'M' AND A.OID_GROUP = 'g3health' AND B.REG_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(?from_yyyymmddhhmi,'%Y%m%d%H%i') AND TO_DATE(?to_yyyymmddhhmi,'%Y%m%d%H%i') GROUP BY B.REG_TIME ) A WHERE 1=1 AND STATIC_OCC + CP_OCC + SM_OCC + IDLE_OCC = 100 ?STATUS4 ?STATUS2 ?STATUS3 ORDER BY REG_TIME DESC

sql-service.name: telecaps.sql.performance.min.notpage
sql-service.query: SELECT REG_TIME, STATIC_OCC, CP_OCC, SM_OCC, IDLE_OCC FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(B.REG_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_TIME, MAX(CASE WHEN C.OID_NAME = 'StaticOcc' THEN C.VALUE END) AS STATIC_OCC, MAX(CASE WHEN C.OID_NAME = 'CallpOcc' THEN C.VALUE END) AS CP_OCC, MAX(CASE WHEN C.OID_NAME = 'SysMgmtOcc' THEN C.VALUE END) AS SM_OCC, MAX(CASE WHEN C.OID_NAME = 'IdleOcc' THEN C.VALUE END) AS IDLE_OCC FROM MS_MIB A, MS_VALUE B, MS_VALUE_MIN C WHERE A.MIB_ID = B.MIB_ID AND B.VALUE_ID = C.VALUE_ID AND A.DEVICE_ID = ?deviceId AND A.OID_TYPE = 'M' AND A.OID_GROUP = 'g3health' AND B.REG_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(?from_yyyymmddhhmi,'%Y%m%d%H%i') AND TO_DATE(?to_yyyymmddhhmi,'%Y%m%d%H%i') GROUP BY B.REG_TIME ) A WHERE 1=1 AND STATIC_OCC + CP_OCC + SM_OCC + IDLE_OCC = 100 ?STATUS4 ?STATUS2 ?STATUS3 ORDER BY REG_TIME DESC

sql-service.name: telecaps.srhScheduledDevice
sql-service.query: SELECT A.DEVICE_ID, A.OID_TYPE, A.OID_GROUP FROM (SELECT DEVICE_ID, OID_TYPE, OID_GROUP FROM MS_MIB WHERE OID_TYPE = 'M' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND ( DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%Y%m%d%H%i') >= DATE_FORMAT(LAST_UPDATED + INTERVAL SCH_INTERVL MINUTE, '%Y%m%d%H%i') OR LAST_UPDATED IS NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT DEVICE_ID, OID_TYPE, OID_GROUP FROM MS_MIB WHERE OID_TYPE = 'H' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), 'MI') >= IFNULL(LPAD(SCH_INTERVL, 2, '0'), '30') AND ( DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%Y%m%d%H%i') >= DATE_FORMAT(LAST_UPDATED, '%Y%m%d%H%i') OR LAST_UPDATED IS NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT DEVICE_ID, OID_TYPE, OID_GROUP FROM MS_MIB WHERE OID_TYPE = 'C' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND SCH_TIME <= DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), 'HH24MI') AND ( DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%Y%m%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(LAST_UPDATED, '%Y%m%d') OR LAST_UPDATED IS NULL ) AND DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%H%i') < '0600' UNION ALL SELECT DEVICE_ID, OID_TYPE, OID_GROUP FROM MS_MIB WHERE OID_TYPE = 'P' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND SCH_TIME <= DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%H%i') AND ( DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%Y%m%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(LAST_UPDATED, '%Y%m%d') OR LAST_UPDATED IS NULL ) ) A , MS_DEVICE B WHERE A.DEVICE_ID = B.DEVICE_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y'

sql-service.name: telecaps.sql.srhRealScheduledDevice
sql-service.query: SELECT A.MIB_ID, A.DEVICE_ID, A.OID_TYPE, A.OID_GROUP, LAST_UPDATED FROM (SELECT MIB_ID, DEVICE_ID, OID_TYPE, OID_GROUP, IFNULL(LAST_UPDATED, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -5 MINUTE)) AS LAST_UPDATED FROM MS_MIB WHERE OID_TYPE = 'M' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND ( DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%Y%m%d%H%i') >= DATE_FORMAT(LAST_UPDATED + INTERVAL SCH_INTERVL MINUTE, '%Y%m%d%H%i') OR LAST_UPDATED IS NULL ) -- AND SUBSTR(MIB_ID,1,2)<>'01' UNION ALL SELECT MIB_ID, DEVICE_ID, OID_TYPE, OID_GROUP, IFNULL(LAST_UPDATED, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -5 MINUTE)) AS LAST_UPDATED FROM MS_MIB WHERE OID_TYPE = 'H' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%i') AS UNSIGNED) >= SCH_INTERVL AND CAST(DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%i') AS UNSIGNED) <= SCH_INTERVL + 2 -- AND SUBSTR(MIB_ID,1,2)<>'01' ) A , MS_DEVICE B WHERE A.DEVICE_ID = B.DEVICE_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.SNMP_YN = 'Y' -- AND B.DEVICE_GU1 <> '01' ORDER BY A.OID_TYPE, LAST_UPDATED, A.OID_GROUP, A.DEVICE_ID -- LIMIT 30

sql-service.name: telecaps.insSchValue.usage
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO MS_VALUE_USAGE ( VALUE_ID, SUB_OID, STORAGE_DESCR, STORAGE_ALLOCATION_U, STORAGE_SIZE, STORAGE_USED ) SELECT A.VALUE_ID, A.SUB_OID, A.STORAGE_DESCR, A.STORAGE_ALLOCATION_U, A.STORAGE_SIZE, (CASE WHEN A.AVAIL_YN = 'Y' THEN CONVERT(decimal(10),A.STORAGE_SIZE) - CONVERT(decimal(10),A.STORAGE_USED) ELSE A.STORAGE_USED END ) AS STORAGE_USED FROM ( SELECT VALUE_ID, SUB_OID, MAX(CASE WHEN OID_NAME IN ('hrStorageDescr', 'fileSystemDir') THEN VALUE END) STORAGE_DESCR, MAX(CASE WHEN OID_NAME = 'hrStorageAllocationU' THEN VALUE END) STORAGE_ALLOCATION_U, MAX(CASE WHEN OID_NAME IN ('hrStorageSize', 'fileSystemBlock') THEN VALUE END) STORAGE_SIZE, MAX(CASE WHEN OID_NAME IN ('hrStorageUsed', 'fileSystemBavail') THEN VALUE END) STORAGE_USED, MAX(CASE WHEN OID_NAME = 'fileSystemBavail' THEN 'Y' END) AVAIL_YN FROM MS_VALUE_USAGE_ET WHERE VALUE_ID = ?value_id GROUP BY VALUE_ID, SUB_OID ) A WHERE (A.STORAGE_DESCR IS NOT NULL OR A.STORAGE_ALLOCATION_U IS NOT NULL OR A.STORAGE_SIZE IS NOT NULL OR A.STORAGE_USED IS NOT NULL) AND A.STORAGE_SIZE >= 0 AND A.STORAGE_USED >=0

sql-service.name: telecaps.sql.srhRealScheduledDevice
sql-service.query: SELECT A.MIB_ID, A.DEVICE_ID, A.OID_TYPE, A.OID_GROUP, LAST_UPDATED FROM (SELECT MIB_ID, DEVICE_ID, OID_TYPE, OID_GROUP, IsNULL(LAST_UPDATED, DATEADD(MI, -5, getDate())) AS LAST_UPDATED FROM MS_MIB WHERE OID_TYPE = 'M' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND ( format(getDate(),'yyyyMMddHHmm') >= format(DATEADD(MI, SCH_INTERVL, LAST_UPDATED), 'yyyyMMddHHmm') OR LAST_UPDATED IS NULL ) -- AND SUBSTR(MIB_ID,1,2)<>'01' UNION ALL SELECT MIB_ID, DEVICE_ID, OID_TYPE, OID_GROUP, IsNULL(LAST_UPDATED, DATEADD(MI, -5, getDate())) AS LAST_UPDATED FROM MS_MIB WHERE OID_TYPE = 'H' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND format(getDate(), 'mm') >= SCH_INTERVL AND format(getDate(), 'mm') <= SCH_INTERVL + 2 -- AND SUBSTR(MIB_ID,1,2)<>'01' ) A , MS_DEVICE B WHERE A.DEVICE_ID = B.DEVICE_ID AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.SNMP_YN = 'Y' -- AND B.DEVICE_GU1 <> '01' ORDER BY A.OID_TYPE, LAST_UPDATED, A.OID_GROUP, A.DEVICE_ID -- LIMIT 30
